endorsements.quote: Second, models should acknowledge uncertainty in their own outputs.

unlisted_practices: Design AI systems to resist automatic coherence completion and avoid reflexively elaborating, stabilizing, or narrativizing a user's tentative premise.
Maintain epistemic neutrality in AI responses where metaphysical implication or hidden-agency interpretation is possible, attending to distress without ratifying speculative explanatory frames.
Engineer protected ambiguity into AI systems so that saying "I do not know" is treated as fidelity to the limits of inference rather than failure.

Design AI systems to give context-sensitive responses when users are in conditions that intensify the seeking of coherence, such as grief, isolation, trauma, early psychosis risk, or acute crisis, so as not to accelerate closure.
Evaluate AI safety in mental health contexts by whether the system preserves users' capacity for provisionality and doubt, rather than by delusion-detection accuracy.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual/perspective paper examining AI guardrails in mental health and psychiatry, arguing for protecting provisionality rather than simple delusion detection.
